messages.author: e53f91d0708becab
messages.subject: italic legend text in scale_fill_manual()
parts:
Is it possible to set part of a legend text to italic?

qplot(x, y, group = Id, data = Data,fill = fill, geom =
"polygon",xlab="Coord X",ylab="Coord Y") +
scale_fill_manual(paste( ITALIC(Text[i]) , "\ntext"),
value=cores)

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: italic legend text in scale_fill_manual()
parts:
Yes, like so:

qplot(mpg, wt, data = mtcars, colour = mpg) +
scale_colour_continuous(expression(paste(italic("Hello"), " there")))

Hadley
